reason: I don't have the capacity to think about this right now. My buyers have never asked to see a home before it's built, and I sell off photos of finished houses, so I'm not going to sit through a lunch demo for something nobody is asking me for.
objection: Nobody's asking for it. I'd be adding one more thing to run on every job, and I'd have to get plans to them and handle revision rounds, when I'm already stretched.
would_change_my_mind: A homeowner or buyer actually asking to walk the house before we break ground, or a sample of one of my own plans that arrives with zero work from me and clearly closes deals faster.
